title: Processing methodology of global anthropogenic emissions for air quality modeling
author: Pino-Cortés

steps.title: Determine month counter
steps.instruction: Identify the zero‑based month index for the desired month; if the NetCDF file contains multiple months, the first month is index 0 (e.g., August 2018 corresponds to index 7).

steps.title: Extract monthly emissions
steps.instruction: Run NCO ncks to select the desired month: ncks -O -d time,<month_index> CAMS_file.nc STEP1_out.nc

steps.title: Delete time attribute
steps.instruction: Remove the global attribute named "time" from STEP1_out.nc: ncwa -O -a time STEP1_out.nc STEP2_out.nc

steps.title: Delete time variable
steps.instruction: Delete the variable "time" from STEP2_out.nc: ncks -C -O -x -v time STEP2_out.nc STEP3_out.nc

steps.title: Convert to NetCDF‑3
steps.instruction: Change the file format to NetCDF classic type 3 (required by SMOKE): ncks -O -3 STEP3_out.nc STEP4_out.nc

steps.title: Select transport sector & lon ranges
steps.instruction: Keep only the transport (tro) sector and limit longitudes to 0‑180° and –180‑0°: ncks -O -v tro –msa -d lon,0.,180. -d lon,-180.,0. STEP4_out.nc STEP5_out.nc

steps.title: Shift longitudes to 0‑360
steps.instruction: Replace negative longitudes with values in the 0‑360° range: ncks -O -s 'where(lon < 0) lon=lon+360' STEP5_out.nc file_for_SMOKE.nc
